d:
Mr Bean gathers borrowed food, greets someone at a door with "Morning" and scolds Teddy for leaving the sofa in this animated compilation. Later he complains about being kept waiting, writes a party invitation and ends up on a boat.
Welcome to the official YouTube home of Mr Bean, the legendary comedy icon loved across the globe! Step into a world of hilarious mishaps, quirky problem-solving, and unforgettable moments that have entertained generations.
